content: {"paper_id":"W4385864334","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"FTLMCM also uses the tensor rotation to better explore the relationships among different views.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文处理多视图聚类，并显式利用张量旋转探索不同视图之间的关系，符合多视图学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"Specifically, the low-rank constraints of the tensor, the frontal slices and the lateral slices of the tensor are imposed on the objective function of the proposed method to achieve these goals.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法在目标函数中对张量及其正面、侧面切片施加低秩约束，属于显式低秩建模。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"Since most existing methods fail to simultaneously characterize the relations among different entries in a tensor from the global perspective and describe local structures of similarity matrices of a tensor, we propose a novel Flexible Tensor Learning for Multi-view Clustering with the Markov chain (FTLMCM) to solve this problem.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要指出要刻画相似度矩阵的局部结构，并提出张量学习来建模这些相似度/亲和结构，符合学习或修正样本亲和矩阵的图结构学习。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
